title: Jamaican Sweetcorn Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with sweetcorn, Jamaican seasonings, and tender beef. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and sauté until softened.
Add the allspice, thyme, bay leaves, and jerk seasoning to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned beef to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Add the sweetcorn to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
